verdict.rationale: Databricks Marketplace offers listings that include third-party datasets (alongside models, notebooks, apps, and MCP servers) from its partner ecosystem. Customers can discover, evaluate, and connect to these offerings directly from their workspace, and OpenSharing provides the underlying cross-organization data sharing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how acquired datasets land in the catalog and are joined with your own data to enrich it, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the analyst enrichment workflow.
